findings.evidence: Lines 39, 50, and 59 declare the three lemmas under `namespace TauCeti`, while Mathlib defines `mkOfDetNeZero` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean:148` in `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup`; the rubric requires extensions whose first explicit argument has an existing Lean/Mathlib type to live in that type’s namespace.
findings.fix: Move these declarations to `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup` and update their in-repository uses and documentation names.
findings.issue: `mkOfDetNeZero_mul`, `mkOfDetNeZero_coe`, and `mkOfDetNeZero_transvection` are declared in `TauCeti`, although they are lemmas about `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mkOfDetNeZero`; the first two also take an existing `Matrix`/`GL` type as their first explicit data argument.

summary: The new `mkOfDetNeZero` API is placed outside the namespace of the existing Mathlib construction and its argument types.
